title: The projected isotropic normal distribution with applications in neuroscience
authors: Antonio Mauricio F. L. Miranda de Sa'
summary: This paper is motivated by a cutting-edge application in neuroscience: the analysis of electroencephalogram (EEG) signals recorded under flash stimulation. Under commonly used signal-processing assumptions, only the phase angle of the EEG is required for the analysis of such applications. We demonstrate that these assumptions imply that the phase has a projected isotropic normal distribution. We revisit this distribution and derive several new properties, including closed-form expressions for its trigonometric moments.
